note: Roles a person can hold in a venture (EE-082). Agent roles are in agent-roles.json.

roles.name: Founder
roles.description: Started the venture and owns it; alone, owns every function

roles.name: Co-founder
roles.description: One of two or more founders; owns the functions the team assigns

roles.name: General partner
roles.description: Runs a fund or firm: sets the thesis, raises from limited partners, makes and manages investments

roles.name: Limited partner
roles.description: Commits capital to a fund and receives reports; does not run it

roles.name: Operator
roles.description: Runs one or more functions without founding the venture: an early employee or executive

roles.name: Advisor
roles.description: Advises the founders; owns no function

roles.name: Board member
roles.description: Sits on the board and governs; owns no function
